release: Downloads History Compaction & Automation Startup Efficiency
name: Downloads History Compaction & Automation Startup Efficiency
changes: Compacts finalized Completed jobs out of the cross-runtime operational ledger only after their durable NewzDeck terminal-history row is committed; failed, retryable and import/cleanup-in-progress jobs remain actionable. The monotonic statistics accounted-ID set is independently capped at the newest 20,000 IDs to prevent secondary ledger growth.
Indexes Completed/Failed terminal history and cached status counts so page reads slice ordered IDs instead of copying and sorting the full 5,000-row history.
Omits the all-history matching-ID list from Completed responses and keeps full Automation context and SAB stage history out of compact page rows while preserving lazy Details.
Prevents recent SAB History from re-adopting finalized jobs already owned by durable NewzDeck terminal history.

Caches Automation sidebar counts against library/profile/config file signatures and local date, cancels startup count probes after the first populated result, and stops full-summary warm retries after success.
Preserves the v3.6.53 NZB identity gate, next-candidate recovery, Smart Import protections, copy-on-write Live Downloads view, queue-sampler evidence and private SABnzbd 5.1.2.
regression_guards: v3.6.53 diagnostic-shaped state must migrate from hundreds of finalized tracked jobs to operational/actionable state while retaining every durable terminal row.

Completed page reads must be bounded to the requested page, exclude matching_ids and rich context/stage logs, while Failed keeps matching_ids for batch removal and Details retains repair-stage evidence.
Finalized Completed rows already in terminal history must not be re-adopted from recent SAB History; failed/actionable rows must remain tracked.
Automation sidebar counts must cache on unchanged inputs and invalidate after a library/profile/config signature change.
Startup JavaScript must cancel remaining sidebar probes after a populated result and suppress redundant full-summary warm retries once state.automation is loaded.
All v3.6.53 NZB identity, SAB 5.1.2, Library Integrity, Selected Episodes and prior release guards remain mandatory.
